name: Chantelle Diachina
reason: Her own site (pranaselfcare.ca) is now mainly a clinical counselling practice (RCC, counselling psychology) with stress-management and workplace wellness services; the yoga and mindful-living offerings are framed around conditions (anxiety, panic attacks, PTSD, menopause, burn-out), so almost nothing passes the health-claim and therapy rules. An email (hello@pranaselfcare.ca) is published on the home page and her base is Victoria, BC, if the owner wants to reconsider.
